_comment: Official USCIS processing times, maintained by hand.
USCIS publishes these at https://egov.uscis.gov/processing-times/ , which sits behind a
Cloudflare bot challenge, so it is not fetched automatically. The numbers change about
once a month and take ten seconds to update: open that page, pick the form/category/office,
and copy the '80% of cases are completed within' figure into the matching entry below.
Set 'months' to the published number and 'as_of' to the date shown on the page.
Entries with months = null render on the page as 'not set yet' rather than a wrong number.
